description: One row per rental: one unit out to one customer for a date range. Open rentals have no returned_date, days or amount yet.

category.description: Item category at the time of rental

out_date.description: Day the unit left the yard

due_date.description: Day the unit is due back

returned_date.description: Day it came back. Empty while still out.

amount.description: Billed amount in USD before tax, including damage, cleaning and fuel charges

damage_notes.description: Check-in notes: damage, leaks, cleaning, late returns

last_modified.description: When the rental record last changed
